chunks: O my son, the world is a deep sea, and many people have perished in it. So make your ship in it faith in Allah, make its sail reliance upon Allah, and make your provision in it taqwa of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
If you are saved, then it is by the mercy of Allah; and if you perish, then it is by your sins.

key_terms.التَّوَكُّلَ عَلَى اللَّهِ: reliance upon Allah, the trust that carries one through trials
key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life, portrayed as a dangerous and deceptive realm
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ بِاللَّهِ: faith in Allah, the foundation of safety and direction
key_terms.بَحْرٌ عَمِيقٌ: a deep sea, symbolizing the world’s peril and difficulty
key_terms.بِذُنُوبِكَ: by your sins, meaning destruction results from one’s own wrongdoing
key_terms.بِرَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ: by the mercy of Allah, indicating that salvation is ultimately through divine mercy
key_terms.تَقْوَى اللَّهِ: God-conscious piety, the spiritual provision needed for survival

ai.seo_question: How does Luqman describe surviving the dangers of the world?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the world as a perilous sea and teaches that salvation within it depends on iman, tawakkul, and taqwa. It also affirms that ultimate deliverance is through Allah’s mercy, while destruction comes through one’s own sins.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2457 - Luqman said to his son:

"O my son, the world is a deep ocean in which many people have drowned. Make your ship in it faith in Allah (swt), make its sail reliance upon Allah (swt), and make your provision in it piety toward Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious.
If you are saved, it is by the mercy of Allah (swt), and if you perish, it is due to your sins."
